task_description: Rebuild ALL remaining SARS template reports (18 of 19) to fixed-layout, exact-page-size, correct-page-count fidelity, matching what src/sars/templates/schools_rank.py already achieves for MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK: emit each reference's own US-Letter page box (792x612 landscape or 612x792 portrait) instead of A4, honour each reference's true page count with correct pagination, keep real embedded Arial/Times New Roman fonts, recovered per-cell fill washes, rotated rank captions, and recovered row pitches, verified per report with cell_diff (aim 0 logical mismatches) and pixel_diff (honest visible% per report, no DIMENSION MISMATCH). Follow the project learning: each report type is its own self-contained artefact; prefer per-report/per-family renderers over shared abstraction. Also fix the confusing output/compare/ naming into one consistent scheme (conversion/ + template/ + pixel/ subfolders with a shared '<name> - page N' stem) and make pixel-to-pixel comparison run for EVERY report via a --all batch mode, not just one. Do not overwrite reference PDFs; keep the conversion path at 19/19 and pytest green.
